items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'his son, they call him Bib' in relation to August Du Pont and Hersey, but Interviewee Danny Barker does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of Bib.

ctx.x: August Du Pont is his name. They called him Dimes. All the musicians would call him Dimes. He played. And my cousin Hersey(?), he played drums. And he has a son, they call him Bib, but his right name is [INDECIPHERABLE]
